blocks.text: Day 8 · After breakfast, comfortable bus to Chivay and the Colca Canyon, one of the deepest and most beautiful canyons in the world. Stops along the way at scenic viewpoints, at Lagunillas lake with its pink flamingos and at a viewpoint over three volcanoes. Arrival in Chivay and check-in; lunch, and the hot springs if you wish.
